Recent projects across San Diego.

Every yard tells you what it needs if you slow down enough to listen. Here are a few we've been particularly proud of.

La Jolla · Irrigation · Pruning · Weed Control

Drought-Tolerant Front Yard

Replaced 1,400 sq ft of thirsty turf with a layered drought-tolerant palette and converted four irrigation zones to drip. Water bill dropped ~60% in the first month.

North Park · Lawn Maintenance · Irrigation

Backyard Lawn Restoration

Brought a patchy, compacted backyard lawn back to a usable family space — aeration, overseed with shade-tolerant Tall Fescue, and a controller upgrade.

Kensington · Hedge Trimming · Pruning

Privacy Hedge Restoration

A neglected 80-foot ficus hedge had grown leggy and hollow inside. Three staged trims over a year brought it back to a dense, intentional privacy screen.

Talmadge · Weed Control · Pruning · Lawn Maintenance

Full Property Cleanup

A new-owner property cleanup — 4 cubic yards of green waste removed, beds remulched, lawn brought back from neglect, and a sustainable weekly schedule set up.

Sorrento Valley · Irrigation
